concerns.text: FR-001 (Aggregation from 3 sources) and US-1 (Independent Test) require the production of a validated CSV. Task T027 is marked [ ] (pending) and is the sole task responsible for generating `data/processed/alloys_raw.csv`. Without this task being marked complete or having a clear alternative, the FR-001 deliverable is missing.

FR-003 (Compute 5 descriptors) and US-2 (Independent Test) require the production of `data/processed/alloys_features.csv`. Task T032 is marked [ ] (pending) and is the sole task responsible for generating this file. The pipeline cannot proceed to modeling (T033+) without this deliverable.

US-2 (Independent Test) and SC-001/SC-002 require performance metrics (R², MAE) to be produced. Task T037 is marked [ ] (pending) and is the sole task responsible for generating `data/processed/model_metrics.json`. This blocks the validation of the model training phase.

Tasks T066, T067, T068, and T069 are marked [ ] (pending). While T066/T067 address data robustness (FR-001), T068 addresses microstructure confounders (FR-010), and T069 addresses physical plausibility (FR-009), their pending status means the specific mitigation strategies for these critical requirements are not yet implemented in the task list.

Task T024b is marked [X] (complete) but lists a dependency on T061 (Plan Amendment). T061 is also marked [X] (complete). However, the Plan artifact (plan.md) still explicitly mandates 'MICE imputation' in Phase 1.2 and Technical Context, while the Spec mandates Mean/Listwise. The task claims the plan is amended, but the artifact text contradicts the task status, creating a stale tag/coverage gap where the plan text does not reflect the implemented logic.
